priorities.summary: Authorization bypass through a user-controlled key in Microsoft Entra Device Registration lets an unauthorized attacker elevate privileges over a network. Microsoft rates it the maximum CVSS 10.0, the most severe CVE published this week.
Kyverno 1.17.0 to 1.19.1 lets namespace tenants abuse NamespacedMutatingPolicy to overwrite resources in other namespaces, including Secrets and Deployments cluster-wide. Fixed in Kyverno 1.19.2.

The payever WooCommerce Gateway plugin for WordPress (up to 4.8.0) exposes unauthenticated API callbacks and writes an attacker-controlled file to the public uploads directory before validating its type, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution.

model.name: Google Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
model.summary: Google's fast video generation and editing model is now generally available, with native clips up to 15 seconds (up from 10), multi-turn conversational editing, and a 30% price cut to $0.07 per second for 720p. It rolls out across the Gemini API, Google Cloud, and Gemini for business.
